about: The Haftarah from the Prophets joins two sticks into one, one for Judah and one for Joseph, just as Judah and Joseph come together again in this week’s portion. The reading from the Apostles is like Joseph’s story. The one his brothers handed over is the one God made great, and through him blessing comes to the whole world.
note: The day the Apostle Shimon Kefa (Peter) bar Yonah was killed (according to Jewish tradition in Megillat Ta’anit, Orach Chaim 580). Christian traditions agree that Shimon was crucified in Rome during the time of Emperor Nero in 64 CE (3825). Yeshua had told him, “When you grow old, you will stretch out your hands and someone else will put your belt on you, and bring you where you do not want to go.’ Now He said this, indicating by what kind of death he would glorify God” (John 21:18–19). It is also the traditional day when Ezra the Scribe died.
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
Did you learn something you need to do in your life?
